mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, author, views, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM posts ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, title, content, author, views, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM posts WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (title, content, author, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{author}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
